fields.title: 📖 The fiṭrah and the misguidance of the shayāṭīn
fields.body:
🖋️ ʿIyāḍ ibn Ḥimār reported that the Prophet ﷺ transmitted from his Lord:

“I created My servants as ḥunafāʾ. Then the shayāṭīn came to them, turned them away from their religion, made forbidden to them what I had permitted them, and commanded them to associate partners with Me, for which I have sent down no proof.”

🌙 Conclusion: The human being is not born with shirk, but upon the fiṭrah — the natural disposition toward tawḥīd. The real danger begins when the shayāṭīn twist the standards and draw hearts away from the truth. Therefore the fiṭrah remains protected only through the Qurʾān and the Sunnah.

immutable.source: 📝 Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ, Nr. 2865; an-Nasāʾī, as-Sunan al-Kubrā, Nr. 8017; Ibn Ḥibbān, Ṣaḥīḥ, Nr. 653.
